Rate salience from 1 to 5: 1 is the worst, none of the points in the summary is important enough to be summarized; 5 is the best, all of the points mentioned in the summary are important and worth to be summarized; Rate faithfulness from 1 to 5: 1 is the worst, all of the sentences in the summary are either wrong or not existing in the email thread; 5 is the best, all of the points mentioned in the summary are true to the thread.
